source.author: cic
source.text: vixisse cum iis equidem videor, ita multi sermones perscripti sunt e quibus dubitari non possit quin Socrati nihil sit visum sciri posse; excepit unum tantum, scire se nihil se scire, nihil amplius.
source.text_original: vixisse cum iis equidem videor, ita multi sermones perscripti sunt e quibus dubitari non possit quin Socrati nihil sit visum sciri posse; excepit unum tantum, scire se nihil se scire, nihil amplius.
source.text_english: I seem to have lived with them myself, so many conversations have been written down from which there can be no doubt that Socrates thought that nothing could be known, except for one single point: that he knew that he knew nothing, and nothing more.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: scio, quod nescio et alterius sapientis:
reuse.text_english: I know that I do not know—and that is the wisdom of another.
